[00:31] Rajesh: totally, and we want a strong use case, maybe a migration story from open model hosting to dedicated serving — that resonates with our audience
[00:40] Eli: one quick thing, do we have any constraints on dates? we were thinking first week of march, maybe tues or weds morning ET to hit europe too
[00:48] Tom: second week is tight for us — ops is lighter the first week — 2025-03-04 or 2025-03-05 both look ok for CloudWave

[02:05] Maya: agree that sounds reasonable — can you confirm UTM params? we prefer utm_source=cloudwave, utm_medium=partner-webinar, utm_campaign=cw-redwood-0325 but we'll follow your naming if you have a standard
